spans.s:
चक् (चकति) pp. चकित (q.v.) tremble, shake, be
alarmed.
चकार m. the word च.
चकास् चकास्ति shine, beam.
चकित a. & n. trembling.
चकोर m. a kind of partridge.

चकोरव्रत m. the practice (lit. vow) of the Cakora
(said to feed on moon-beams);
 ˚व्रतमालम्ब् follow the practice of the
Cakora (i.e. enjoy the sight of a moon-like face).
चकोरनेत्र f. ई partridge-eyed.
चको˚राक्ष f. ई partridge-eyed.

चक्रगोप्तृ m. guardian of the wheel (scil. of the
king's chariot), trabant.

चक्रधर a. & m. having a wheel or a discus, a
sovereign or Viṣṇu.
चक्रनाभि f. the nave of a wheel.
चक्रभङ्ग m. the breaking of a wheel.
चक्ररक्ष m. = चक्रगोप्तृ.
चक्र˚रक्षिन्* m. = चक्रगोप्तृ.
चक्ररत्न n. an excellent (lit. jewel of a) discus.
चक्रवद्गति a. moving like a wheel, turning round.
चक्रवर्तिता f. ˚त्व n. abstr. to seq.

चक्रवाक॑ m. ई f. the Cakravāka, a kind of goose or
duck.
चक्रवात m. whirlwind, hurricane.
चक्रवाल n. orb, circle, troop, multitude.

चक्रवृद्धि f. compound interest or freight-money
(lit. wheel-profit).
चक्रव्यूह m. a circular array of troops.
चक्राङ्कित a. marked with a (mystic) circle.
चक्राङ्ग f. ई a kind of goose or flamingo.
चक्राह्व m. = चक्रवाक.
चक्राह्वय m. = चक्रवाक.
च॑क्रि a. making, active.

चक्रिन् a. having wheels or a discus, driving in a chariot;
m. sovereign, king, serpent, E. of Viṣṇu or Śiva.
च॑क्षण n. appearance, aspect.
चक्ष॑णि m. who illuminates.
च॑क्षन् n. eye.
च॑क्षु m. eye.
चक्षुर्विषय m. range of sight, visibility.
चक्षुष्पथ m. range of sight, visibility.
चक्षुष्प्रीति f. joy of the eye.
च॑क्षुष्मन्त् a. having eyes, seeing.

चक्षुष्य a. wholesome or agreeable to the eyes, pleasing,
beautiful, dear.
चक्षूराग m. delight of the eye.
चाक्रिक m. carrier, potter, oil-maker.

चाक्षुष॑ f. ई pertaining to the eye or sight, visible;
m. patron, of the sixth Manu.
चाक्ष्म॑ a. content, forbearing, gracious.
